source: Original costume, hair, gloves, equipment, creatures and environment authored by repository scripts; anatomical head/neck derived from the CC0 MakeHuman base mesh and female-young target

anatomy.used: Head/neck subset only; no source body/helper meshes are delivered

format: glTF 2.0 binary, baked vertex AO, TEXCOORD_0 surface IDs and TEXCOORD_1 material/anatomical UVs
surfaces: Native Three.js physical materials, independently mapped measured normal/roughness textures from Poly Haven CC0 and head-only MakeHuman CC0 skin. See assets/pbr/sources.json and derived.json. Original key-art costume colors retained in authored vertex colors; no image overlays.
lighting: Poly Haven snow_field_2 HDR processed at runtime with PMREM; local bundled files only, no external API or CDN at runtime
animation: Six authored AnimationMixer clips plus analytic two-link shoulder/elbow reach and wrist orientation in axe-equipment.js; one physical hatchet with belt/hand attachment and a covered blade at rest
referenceOnly: Original Frostline title key art v15 is the material and costume direction, not a gameplay background or billboard; no claim of equal key-art fidelity at runtime
